observations: White salon bonnet/hood hair dryer with a clear plastic visor/hood, photographed from above and front (photos 0,1).
Black trim panel on top shows a brand name 'EQUATOR' along with a decorative red/pink motif and a small lit red indicator light (photo 0, photo 1).
Interior of the hood shows a ribbed white heating/air grille and some brown/dark staining or residue near the base of the clear hood (photo 1).

Close-up (photo 2) shows the clear plastic hood with visible scuffs/scratches and a thin metal rod at the bottom edge, possibly part of a stand, but the stand itself (base, height-adjustable leg) is not fully shown in any photo.
No power cord, plug, or full stand/leg is visible in any of the three photos.
No model number or additional nameplate text is legible beyond the 'EQUATOR' brand mark.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows visible brown/dark staining inside the hood near the base, and photo 2 shows scuff marks on the clear plastic, inconsistent with 'like new' condition.
No photo shows the full stand or leg; only a thin rod edge is glimpsed at the bottom of photo 2.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat properly despite the lit indicator light shown
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the dryer running with visible heat/airflow from the hood

risks.risk: Stand/leg could be missing, mismatched, or damaged (height adjustment, wheels, stability)
risks.proof: A full-length photo showing the entire stand from base to hood
risks.if_unproven: priced as if stand condition is unknown/worst case (treated as needing replacement)

risks.risk: Power cord and plug condition unknown (fraying, exposed wires, non-standard plug)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full cord and plug

risks.risk: Interior staining could indicate mold, heat damage, or long-term disuse affecting hygiene/performance
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stained area and a wipe-test photo

proof_requests: Video of the dryer powered on, showing heat and airflow from the hood
Full-length photo of the stand/leg from base to hood
Clear photo of the power cord and plug
Close-up of the stained area inside the hood
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a branded (Equator) standing bonnet hair dryer, but the 'like new' and 'with leg' claims are unverified or contradicted by visible wear and missing stand photos, so it must be priced at worst case (non-confirmed working, stand condition unknown) pending further proof.
